verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ חִלְקִיָּ֑הוּ מִן־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֔וֹת בְּאֶ֖רֶץ בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê yir·mə·yā·hū ben- ḥil·qî·yā·hū min- hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ă·šer ba·‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ bə·’e·reṣ bin·yā·min
verses.literal: These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah one of the priests in Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו בִּימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה בִּשְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lāw bî·mê yō·šî·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wn me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh biš·lōš- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lə·mā·lə·ḵōw
verses.literal: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah . . . in the thirteenth . . . year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַד־ תֹּם֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְצִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה עַד־ גְּל֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî bî·mê yə·hō·w·yā·qîm ben- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ- tōm ‘aš·tê ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lə·ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ḇen- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ- gə·lō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim ba·ḥō·ḏeš ha·ḥă·mî·šî
verses.literal: and through the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah until . . . the fifth month of the eleventh . . . year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah when the people of Jerusalem went into exile
The word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: בְּטֶ֨רֶם אֶצּוֹרְךָ בַבֶּ֙טֶן֙ יְדַעְתִּ֔יךָ וּבְטֶ֛רֶם תֵּצֵ֥א מֵרֶ֖חֶם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֑יךָ נָבִ֥יא לַגּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem ʾɛṣ·ṣō·rə·ḵå̄ ḇab·be·ṭen yə·ḏa‘·tî·ḵā ū·ḇə·ṭe·rem tê·ṣê mê·re·ḥem hiq·daš·tî·ḵā nā·ḇî lag·gō·w·yim nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you and before you were born . . . I set you apart and appointed you as a prophet to the nations

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה לֹא־ יָדַ֖עְתִּי דַּבֵּ֑ר כִּי־ נַ֖עַר אָנֹֽכִי׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·hāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nêh lō- yā·ḏa‘·tî dab·bēr kî- na·‘ar ’ā·nō·ḵî
verses.literal: Ah Lord GOD I said I surely do not know how to speak for I am only a child

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י אַל־ תֹּאמַ֖ר נַ֣עַר אָנֹ֑כִי כִּ֠י עַֽל־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֶֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוְּךָ֖ תְּדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’al- tō·mar na·‘ar ’ā·nō·ḵî kî ‘al- kāl- ’ă·šer ’eš·lā·ḥă·ḵā tê·lêḵ wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·ṣaw·wə·ḵā tə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: But the LORD told me Do not say I am only a child For to everyone I send you you must go and all that I command you you must speak

verses.original: אַל־ תִּירָ֖א מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י לְהַצִּלֶ֖ךָ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rā mip·pə·nê·hem kî- ’it·tə·ḵā ’ă·nî lə·haṣ·ṣi·le·ḵā nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Do not be afraid of them for I am with you to deliver you declares the LORD

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ וַיַּגַּ֖ע עַל־ פִּ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי דְבָרַ֖י בְּפִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ Yah·weh ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw way·yag·ga‘ ‘al- pî way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay hin·nêh nā·ṯat·tî ḏə·ḇā·ray bə·p̄î·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the LORD reached out His hand touched . . . my mouth and said . . . to me Behold I have put My words in your mouth

verses.original: רְאֵ֞ה הִפְקַדְתִּ֣יךָ׀ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה עַל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ וְעַל־ הַמַּמְלָכ֔וֹת לִנְת֥וֹשׁ וְלִנְת֖וֹץ וּלְהַאֲבִ֣יד וְלַהֲר֑וֹס לִבְנ֖וֹת וְלִנְטֽוֹעַ׃פ
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh hip̄·qaḏ·tî·ḵā hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ‘al- hag·gō·w·yim wə·‘al- ham·mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ lin·ṯō·wōš wə·lin·ṯō·wṣ ū·lə·ha·’ă·ḇîḏ wə·la·hă·rō·ws liḇ·nō·wṯ wə·lin·ṭō·w·a‘
verses.literal: See I have appointed you today . . . over nations . . . and kingdoms to uproot and tear down to destroy and overthrow to build and plant

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֔ר מָה־ אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וָאֹמַ֕ר מַקֵּ֥ל שָׁקֵ֖ד אֲנִ֥י רֹאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr māh- ’at·tāh rō·’eh yir·mə·yā·hū wā·’ō·mar maq·qêl šā·qêḏ ’ă·nî rō·’eh
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to me asking Jeremiah what do you see I see a branch of an almond tree I replied

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י הֵיטַ֣בְתָּ לִרְא֑וֹת כִּֽי־ שֹׁקֵ֥ד אֲנִ֛י עַל־ דְּבָרִ֖י לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay hê·ṭaḇ·tā lir·’ō·wṯ kî- šō·qêḏ ’ă·nî ‘al- də·ḇā·rî la·‘ă·śō·ṯōw
verses.literal: You have observed correctly said the LORD for I am watching over My word to accomplish it

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֤ה׀ אֵלַי֙ שֵׁנִ֣ית לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָאֹמַ֗ר סִ֤יר נָפ֙וּחַ֙ אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֔ה וּפָנָ֖יו מִפְּנֵ֥י צָפֽוֹנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay šê·nîṯ lê·mōr māh ’at·tāh rō·’eh wā·’ō·mar sîr nā·p̄ū·aḥ ’ă·nî rō·’eh ū·p̄ā·nāw mip·pə·nê ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me asking What do you see I see a boiling pot I replied and it is tilting toward us from the north

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י מִצָּפוֹן֙ תִּפָּתַ֣ח הָרָעָ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāy miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn tip·pā·ṯaḥ hā·rā·‘āh ‘al kāl- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Disaster from the north will be poured out on all who live in the land

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ הִנְנִ֣י קֹרֵ֗א לְכָֽל־ מִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת צָפ֖וֹנָה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וּבָ֡אוּ וְֽנָתְנוּ֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּסְא֜וֹ פֶּ֣תַח׀ שַׁעֲרֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וְעַ֤ל כָּל־ חוֹמֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nî qō·rê lə·ḵāl miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh nə·’um- Yah·weh ū·ḇā·’ū wə·nā·ṯə·nū ’îš kis·’ōw pe·ṯaḥ ša·‘ă·rê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·‘al kāl- ḥō·w·mō·ṯe·hā sā·ḇîḇ wə·‘al kāl- ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: For . . . I am about to summon all the clans and kingdoms of the north declares the LORD Their kings will come . . . and set up their thrones at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem They will attack all her surrounding . . . walls and all the other cities of Judah

verses.original: וְדִבַּרְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּטַי֙ אוֹתָ֔ם עַ֖ל כָּל־ רָעָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי וַֽיְקַטְּרוּ֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לְמַעֲשֵׂ֥י יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏib·bar·tî miš·pā·ṭay ’ō·w·ṯām ‘al kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ă·zā·ḇū·nî way·qaṭ·ṭə·rū lê·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lə·ma·‘ă·śê yə·ḏê·hem
verses.literal: I will pronounce My judgments against them for all their wickedness because they have forsaken Me and they have burned incense to other gods and worshiped the works of their own hands

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ תֶּאְזֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֔יךָ וְקַמְתָּ֙ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑ךָּ אַל־ תֵּחַת֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם פֶּֽן־ אֲחִתְּךָ֖ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh te’·zōr mā·ṯə·ne·ḵā wə·qam·tā wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ṣaw·we·kā ’al- tê·ḥaṯ mip·pə·nê·hem pen- ’ă·ḥit·tə·ḵā lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: Get yourself ready . . . Stand up and tell . . . them everything that I command you Do not be intimidated by them or I will terrify you before them

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נְתַתִּ֣יךָ הַיּ֗וֹם לְעִ֨יר מִבְצָ֜ר וּלְעַמּ֥וּד בַּרְזֶ֛ל וּלְחֹמ֥וֹת נְחֹ֖שֶׁת עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ לְמַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ לְשָׂרֶ֔יהָ לְכֹהֲנֶ֖יהָ וּלְעַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hin·nêh nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā hay·yō·wm lə·‘îr miḇ·ṣār ū·lə·‘am·mūḏ bar·zel ū·lə·ḥō·mō·wṯ nə·ḥō·šeṯ ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh lə·śā·re·hā lə·ḵō·hă·ne·hā ū·lə·‘am hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now behold this day I have made you like a fortified city an iron pillar and bronze walls against the whole land against the kings of Judah its officials its priests and the people of the land

verses.original: וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְלֹא־ י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה לְהַצִּילֶֽךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nil·ḥă·mū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·lō- yū·ḵə·lū lāḵ kî- ’it·tə·ḵā ’ă·nî nə·’um- Yah·weh lə·haṣ·ṣî·le·ḵā
verses.literal: They will fight against you but will never overcome you since I am with you to deliver you declares the LORD
